run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser: ServiceNow read over cnit and the Scripted REST API as sf.integration, Salesforce read over the sf CLI and anonymous Apex against the deployed classes. Every case reads both sides.

case.title: The inbound user is sf.integration and only sf.integration

steps.text: List the tasks most recently written by sf.integration.
Confirm the account exists, is active, and holds the integration role rather than admin.
Confirm the outbound push rules skip writes made by that user.

expected: Every inbound write shows sys_updated_by = sf.integration.
The echo-loop guard keys off this user; any other account silently disables it.
actual: 1 task(s) carry sys_updated_by = sf.integration; all distinct values: sf.integration
Push business rule references sf.integration in its echo guard: true
case.verdictReason: Inbound writes are attributed to sf.integration and the guard keys off exactly that name.
